# Base64

Base64 in its standard and URL-safe alphabets, with or without padding, and a view that prints it.

<h2 id="base64-variant"><code>Base64Variant</code></h2>

```rux
pub enum Base64Variant {
    Standard,
    StandardUnpadded,
    Url,
    UrlUnpadded
}
```

Which Base64 alphabet a text uses, and whether it is padded.
Copy, carrying no payload.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L17)

**Cases**

| Name               | Description                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `Standard`         | The standard alphabet ending in `+` and `/`, padded with `=` to a multiple of four characters. RFC 4648 section 4, and what MIME, PEM and most protocols mean by Base64. |
| `StandardUnpadded` | The standard alphabet without padding.                                                                                                                                   |
| `Url`              | The URL- and file-name-safe alphabet ending in `-` and `_`, padded. RFC 4648 section 5.                                                                                  |
| `UrlUnpadded`      | The URL-safe alphabet without padding, which is what JSON Web Tokens and most URL parameters use.                                                                        |

<h2 id="base64-encoded-length"><code>Base64EncodedLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base64EncodedLength(
    length: uint,
    form: Base64Variant
) -> uint
```

How many characters the Base64 form of `length` bytes occupies in `form`.
Four characters for every three bytes, with a final partial group taking two or three characters, or four with
padding. Cannot fail for any length a slice in memory can have; runs in constant time and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L46)

**Parameters**

| Name     | Type            | Description                             |
| -------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `length` | `uint`          | the number of bytes to encode           |
| `form`   | `Base64Variant` | the alphabet and padding to encode with |

**Returns**: the number of characters [`Base64Encode`](/docs/api/encoding/base64#base64-encode) writes

<h2 id="base64-encode"><code>Base64Encode</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base64Encode(
    bytes: byte[..],
    into: var char8[..],
    form: Base64Variant
) -> uint ! FormatError

pub func Base64Encode(
    text: char8[..],
    into: var char8[..],
    form: Base64Variant
) -> uint ! FormatError
```

Writes `bytes` as Base64 into `into`.
Runs in time that depends only on the length of `bytes`. Reports `InsufficientCapacity` when `into` is shorter
than `Base64EncodedLength(bytes.length, form)`, leaving it exactly as it was; room past the encoded form is
not touched.

| Overload                                                                                                 | Summary                                           |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Base64Encode(bytes: byte[..], into: var char8[..], form: Base64Variant) -> uint ! FormatError` | Writes `bytes` as Base64 into `into`.             |
| `pub func Base64Encode(text: char8[..], into: var char8[..], form: Base64Variant) -> uint ! FormatError` | Writes the bytes of `text` as Base64 into `into`. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L63)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                    |
| ------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `bytes` | `byte[..]`      | the bytes to encode                                                            |
| `into`  | `var char8[..]` | the destination, at least `Base64EncodedLength(bytes.length, form)` characters |
| `form`  | `Base64Variant` | the alphabet and padding to encode with                                        |
| `text`  | `char8[..]`     | the text whose bytes to encode                                                 |

**Returns**: the number of characters written

<h2 id="base64-decoded-length"><code>Base64DecodedLength</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base64DecodedLength(
    text: char8[..],
    form: Base64Variant
) -> uint ! DecodeError
```

How many bytes the Base64 text decodes to, after checking its length and the placement of its padding.
Only the shape is checked; the characters are checked by [`Base64Decode`](/docs/api/encoding/base64#base64-decode). A padded variant needs a multiple of four
characters with at most two `=` at the end; an unpadded one any length except one more than a multiple of four,
and no `=` at all. Reports `InvalidLength` at the end of the text, or `InvalidPadding` at the first `=` that is
out of place. Runs in time linear in the length and allocates nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L144)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type            | Description                                          |
| ------ | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]`     | the Base64 text                                      |
| `form` | `Base64Variant` | the alphabet and padding the text is expected to use |

**Returns**: the number of bytes [`Base64Decode`](/docs/api/encoding/base64#base64-decode) writes for it

<h2 id="base64-decode"><code>Base64Decode</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Base64Decode(
    text: char8[..],
    into: var byte[..],
    form: Base64Variant
) -> uint ! DecodeError
```

Reads Base64 text in `form` into `into`.
Runs in time that depends only on the length of `text` when the text is valid. Reports, in this order of
precedence, `InvalidLength` or `InvalidPadding` for a text of the wrong shape, `InvalidCharacter` at the first
character outside the variant's alphabet, `NonCanonical` at a last character whose unused bits are not zero, and
`InsufficientCapacity` with the length needed when `into` is too short. Every refusal leaves `into` untouched,
because the whole text is checked before anything is written.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L171)

**Parameters**

| Name   | Type            | Description                                                       |
| ------ | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text` | `char8[..]`     | the Base64 text to decode                                         |
| `into` | `var byte[..]`  | the destination, at least `Base64DecodedLength(text, form)` bytes |
| `form` | `Base64Variant` | the alphabet and padding the text is expected to use              |

**Returns**: the number of bytes written

<h2 id="base64-view"><code>Base64View</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Base64View {
    // private fields
}
```

A borrowed byte sequence that renders as Base64 under a format placeholder.
Lets a caller write `Render("{}", ViewBase64(key))` instead of sizing a buffer first. The view borrows the bytes
and must not outlive them. Copy, owning nothing.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L234)

**Implements Display**

`Base64View` conforms to `Display`.

<h3 id="base64-view-write-display"><code>WriteDisplay</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WriteDisplay(
    self: &Base64View,
    writer: &var TextWriter,
    spec: FormatSpec
) -> ! FormatError
```

Writes the bytes as Base64, padded to the placeholder's width.
The text is produced in blocks, so rendering allocates nothing however long the bytes are. Reports whatever the
writer reported, and `UnsupportedRequest` for a precision or a style.

| Name     | Type              | Description                    |
| -------- | ----------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `writer` | `&var TextWriter` | the destination                |
| `spec`   | `FormatSpec`      | what the placeholder asked for |

**Returns**: success when the whole rendering was accepted

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L257)

<h2 id="view-base64"><code>ViewBase64</code></h2>

```rux
pub func ViewBase64(
    bytes: byte[..],
    form: Base64Variant
) -> Base64View
```

Borrows `bytes` for rendering as Base64.
Cannot fail and allocates nothing; the view reads `bytes` each time it is rendered, so it must not outlive them.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Encoding/Src/Base64.rux#L245)

**Parameters**

| Name    | Type            | Description                             |
| ------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `bytes` | `byte[..]`      | the bytes to render                     |
| `form`  | `Base64Variant` | the alphabet and padding to render with |

**Returns**: a view that renders `bytes` as Base64
